dedupe_keys.name: eia wholesale electricity and natural gas market data ice daily hub prices

description: The EIA wholesale electricity and natural gas market data page contains daily price and volume series for seven major North American electricity hubs and their corresponding natural gas trading hubs, produced by the U.S. Energy Information Administration from data collected by the Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) and republished with ICE's permission. Each row gives trade date, delivery start and end dates, high and low price, weighted-average price, traded volume, for day-ahead or real-time products such as Mass Hub, PJM West, Indiana Hub, ERCOT North, Mid-C, NP15, SP15 and Palo Verde. Coverage is the United States, with electricity history starting between 2001 and 2014 depending on the hub and natural gas history from March 2014. Access: yearly Excel workbooks (current year plus a 2014 to 2025 archive) downloaded from the page, with no registration; updates arrive every two weeks. Licence and cost: free to download, but the page states no licence, and hubs or periods not covered by EIA's agreement must be bought from ICE. Caveats: prices are spot indices from traded contracts, not system operator settlement data, and the listed products are peak-hour prices. It suits market stress and price-spike studies, such as the winter storm and heat wave periods when scarcity pricing revealed grid strain, and capacity planning inputs. It complements EIA Open Data and the EIA-930 hourly grid monitor already catalogued here.
